description: This file contains Go source code implementing reflection-based utilities for processing struct fields and JSON tags, including functions for looking up metadata, sorting fields, and handling JSON tag options.

methods.name: LookupPatchMetadataForStruct
methods.description: Finds patch strategy and merge key metadata for a struct field based on JSON field name.

methods.name: String
methods.description: Returns a string representation of a field struct.

methods.name: fillField
methods.description: Initializes a field struct with byte name and folding function.

methods.name: Less
methods.description: Comparison functions for sorting fields by name and index.

methods.name: typeFields
methods.description: Returns recognized JSON fields for a given struct type using BFS.

methods.name: dominantField
methods.description: Determines the dominant struct field among fields with the same name.

methods.name: cachedTypeFields
methods.description: Caches and retrieves struct fields recognized for JSON.

methods.name: isValidTag
methods.description: Checks if a string is a valid JSON struct tag.

methods.name: foldFunc
methods.description: Returns a case-insensitive comparison function for a given byte slice.

methods.name: equalFoldRight
methods.description: Specialized ASCII fold comparison considering special Unicode characters.

methods.name: asciiEqualFold
methods.description: ASCII case-insensitive comparison for byte slices.

methods.name: simpleLetterEqualFold
methods.description: Simplified ASCII case-insensitive comparison for letters only.

methods.name: parseTag
methods.description: Splits a JSON struct tag into name and options.

methods.name: Contains
methods.description: Checks if a specific option is present in a comma-separated tag options string.
